author: Joshua Fluke
description:
Job seekers keep getting told the same advice: network more, improve your communication skills, use AI, complete your Indeed profile, activate your network, and somehow “stand out” from hundreds of other applicants doing exactly the same thing.

So how do people actually get hired in the 2026 job market?

In this video, we're looking at some of the increasingly useless job-search and career advice being given to people trying to find work right now.

One video promises the six skills employers “actually want” — things like communication, collaboration, creative thinking and problem solving.

Another solution is apparently to start your own business and hire yourself.
Then we get AI-powered job-search advice that somehow turns into completing your Indeed profile.

And when new graduates ask how to break into a difficult job market, the answer becomes the corporate classic:

“Activate your network.”

title: THE REAL WAY PEOPLE GET HIRED IN 2026
